Tatkal Desk

Simplifying the Tatkal Booking Experience

Tatkal Desk is an independent booking-assistance service designed to help users with their Tatkal railway ticket booking requests during high-demand booking periods.

Our aim is to provide a structured and convenient way for customers to submit their genuine booking requirements and receive assistance from our dedicated booking team.

Our Purpose

Tatkal booking can be highly time-sensitive and highly competitive. Tatkal Desk provides a clear and organized way for users to submit their booking requirements and receive assistance from our team.

Our Commitment

We believe in clear communication, responsible handling of requests, transparent updates, and customer trust. Every request is verified before proceeding, and customers are kept informed about the booking outcome through the website and registered WhatsApp number.

Meet the People Behind Tatkal Desk

Tatkal Desk is supported by a dedicated team working together to manage customer requests and assist with booking attempts during busy booking periods.

Important Information

Tatkal Desk is an independent booking-assistance service and is not an official website, application, or service of Indian Railways or IRCTC.

Ticket availability, fares, confirmation, and booking outcomes are subject to availability and applicable railway booking rules.

FAQ

What is Tatkal Desk?
An independent Tatkal booking-assistance service.
How does it work?
Submit your request → Verify → Pay → Booking Attempt → Get Result.
Is booking guaranteed?
No. Booking depends on availability.
How will I get the result?
Through website notifications and WhatsApp.
What if my ticket is not booked?
The full amount will be refunded as per our Refund Policy.
How can I check my request?
Use your mobile number in My Request.
Is Tatkal Desk an official railway service?
No. It is an independent booking-assistance service.

Privacy Policy

We collect necessary passenger, journey, and contact information to process your booking request.

Your information is used only for request processing, communication, booking assistance, and applicable refunds.

We do not sell your personal information.

For privacy concerns, contact us through Contact Us.

Terms & Conditions

  • Provide accurate passenger and journey details.
  • Submit genuine booking requests.
  • Payment is required after request confirmation.
  • Booking is subject to availability and is not guaranteed.
  • Booking results will be shared through the website and WhatsApp.
  • Refunds follow our Refund Policy.
  • Tatkal Desk is an independent service and is not affiliated with Indian Railways or IRCTC.

Refund Policy

If the requested ticket cannot be booked, the full amount received will be refunded.

The refund will be initiated after the unsuccessful booking is confirmed.

Refund processing time may vary depending on the payment provider or bank.

For refund assistance, contact us through Contact Us.
